$comment: A SYNTHETIC example — every bug, module, name and URL here is invented. It exercises the whole contract (the client's own severity scale · severity provenance, owner vs agent-proposed with the branch that fired · module provenance, container/subject/parent/summary-inferred/agent-placed/unplaced · the General debt band · evidence hostRisk · a module that was tested and came back clean) so a teammate can run the tools end to end before touching real data. NEVER put a client's bugs in the kit: the kit ships.

source.note: Synthetic example. The tracker records no severity, so every severity here was assigned outside it — see severitySource on each row.

issues.summary: The order is charged but never appears in the order history after paying by card.
issues.notes: Reported by two customers in one day.

issues.summary: The promo-code field rejects a valid code on the first attempt; it works on the second.
issues.severityRationale: core feature broken, but the user can still get there — it works on a retry

issues.summary: The total is right-aligned, while the mockup aligns it left.
issues.severityRationale: cosmetic — nothing is hidden and nothing behaves incorrectly

issues.summary: Sign-in with a third-party provider fails with "Authentication failed": a user who registered that way cannot get in at all.
issues.severityRationale: no access to the app — there is no other door for those users

issues.summary: The account name is clipped inside its card when it is longer than 20 characters.
issues.severityRationale: the design deviation CUTS the text — seen on the evidence, not read off the sentence

issues.summary: Exporting orders to CSV drops every row after the first thousand, with no warning.
issues.notes: Silent truncation — the export looks complete.

issues.summary: The status filter keeps its previous value after the page is reloaded.
issues.severityRationale: works, but not per spec / a secondary flow — nobody is blocked

issues.summary: The bottom navigation bar has too much padding on every screen.
issues.severityRationale: cosmetic — app-wide, and it names no single place

issues.summary: The layout breaks on the Orders and Reports screens when the system font size is increased.
issues.severityRationale: unreadable for users who need large type — but it names TWO places, so it is filed under neither
